## 
```{r check_countries}

load("data/data_edgar.RData")

data_cb_china <- read.csv("sources/Myllyvirta_final_co2_timeseries_2026Q2.csv") %>% 
  mutate(iso="CHN",country="China") %>% 
  filter(product=="Total") %>% 
  mutate(year=str_extract(date, "\\d{4}")) %>% 
  group_by(iso,country,year) %>% 
  summarise(value=sum(CO2)) %>% 
  filter(year<2026)

data_cb_india <- read.csv("sources/Myllyvirta_India_CO2_2024-2025.csv") %>% 
  mutate(iso="IND",country="India") %>% 
  filter(fuel=="Grand Total") %>% 
  mutate(year=str_extract(date, "\\d{4}")) %>% 
  group_by(iso,country,year) %>% 
  summarise(value=sum(value)) %>% 
  filter(year<2026)

data_cb <- rbind(data_cb_china,data_cb_india) %>% 
  mutate(source="Myllyvirta 2026") %>% 
  mutate(year=as.numeric(year))

data_cb <- data_cb %>% 
  rbind(.,data_edgar %>% 
      filter(year>=2010) %>% 
      filter(iso %in% c("CHN","IND")) %>% 
      filter(gas =="CO2 Fossil") %>% 
      group_by(iso,country,year) %>% 
      summarise(value=sum(value,na.rm=T)/1e6) %>% 
      mutate(source="EDGAR v2026"))

  
data_cb %>% ggplot(.,aes(x=year,y=value,color=source,group=source)) +
  geom_path() +
  facet_wrap(.~country) +
  theme_wl()


data_ei <- read.xlsx("sources/EI-Stats-Review-ALL-data.xlsx",sheet=5,startRow=3)




```
